membership._note: Demo fees for the pitch; set by Copperstate before launch.

box._note: Mix and match: any `size` items in one order take `pct` percent off the member subtotal. Replaces the old per-brand bundles.

subscribe._note: Subscribe & Save (replaces the monthly box): each item repeats on its own schedule. pct off every subscribed delivery; pct_multi once a member has multi_at or more subscriptions.
